sentences.text:
Cra No. 4321 of 2022
(Sahulal Kaul @ Manoj Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh ) Dated : 11-11-2024 Shri
Dhananjay Chaturvedi - Advocate for the appellant.

Shri Akhilendra Singh - Government Advocate
for the State.

Heard on I.A. No.11420/2022, which is first application filed under Section 389(1) of Code of
Criminal Procedure, 1973 for suspension of sentence and grant of bail on behalf of sole appellant
Sahulal Kaul alias Manoj.

The appellant has been convicted for offences punishable under Sections 450 and 376(2)(l) of IPC and Section 92(kh) of the Right of Disabled Persons Act, 2016 and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 7 years, R.I. for 20 years and R.I. for 3 years with fine of Rs.1,000/-, Rs.2,000/- and Rs.500/-,
respectively with default stipulations vide judgment dated 10.03.2022 passed by learned X Additional Sessions Judge and Special Judge (O.A.W.), Bhopal, in S.T. No. 501/2020.

entities.text: X Additional Sessions Judge and Special Judge (O.A.W.), Bhopal
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Relevant facts for the decision of this application are that prosecutrix in this case is a blind lady who was working at the post of Manager in a nationalised bank; on the night of 17.4.2020 she was all alone in the house; it was a period of lockdown; as the balcony gate was open, some person came inside her room and committed rape and unnatural sex with her; due to blindness she could not recognize the face but became aware of his body shape; during the course of commission of crime,
the rapist had uttered some 2 CRA-4321-2022 words which were sufficient for the victim to recognize his voice; after the commission of crime, he left the house while the prosecutrix came into the balcony and screamed for help; the outer doors of some of the neighbours were locked from outside; the crime was reported to Police Station, Shahpura, district Bhopal, where FIR at Crime No.196/2020 was registered.
During investigation, the appellant was nabbed and items belonging to victim, including her mobile phone, were recovered from him.
Both the prosecutrix and the appellant were medically examined and blood sample of appellant was also taken; the DNA report received in the case was partially positive.
Accordingly, the appellant was convicted and sentenced.

The grounds raised by learned counsel for appellant are that the appellant is a young aged person who is in custody since 24.4.2020; the report was made against an unknown person and the prosecutrix being blind did not see the face of offender; merely on the basis of assumption, the appellant was implicated in the crime; the disposal of appeal is likely to take considerable time; test Sahulal Kaul @ Manoj vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/77336454/

sentences.text:
identification parade on the basis of recognition of voice could not have been relied upon; further,
the identification of articles was also not proved.
Based on these grounds, a request for suspension of sentence was made.
Learned Government Advocate for the State has opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.

The facts of the case relevant in the decision of application are that the victim in this case was a well-educated lady working as Manager in a nationalised bank and that fact itself suggests that she had well developed 3 CRA-4321-2022 cognitive abilities despite her blindness and this fact gains support from her claim that besides doing the job, she manages her house chores as well.
The evidence about recognition of a person on the basis of his voice cannot be brushed aside, particularly when the evidence given on that point has remained unchallenged.
The positive DNA report gives strength to the prosecution story that the victim was raped by the appellant.
No explanation has been offered by the appellant during his examination under Section 313 Cr.P.C. regarding these important pieces of evidence.

Taking into consideration the aforesaid facts and the evidence available on record, we are of the considered opinion that the application for suspension of sentence moved on behalf of appellant cannot be allowed.
The application is accordingly dismissed.
List the case for final hearing in due course.
(VIVEK RUSIA) (ANURA  JUDGE
